name: Patrie's Raspberries on the Prairie
description: In Bowdon, ND, Patrie's Raspberries on the Prairie raises Raspberries on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
